name: Une carte postale de Finlande
source:
Helsinki, Finland. Leo, a student, returns to his apartment. His roommate and friend Valt should be back. However, Valt's hanged corpse is what Leo sees first when he returns.

Valt did not have any reason to commit suicide. Is this really a suicide? Or did something more terrible happen before?

[From [url=https://fflo.itch.io/a-postcard-from-finland]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
芬兰赫尔辛基。学生利奥回到自己的公寓。他的室友兼朋友霸特应该回来了。然而，里奥回来后首先看到的就是霸斗的吊尸。

霸斗没有任何自杀的理由。这真的是自杀吗？还是之前发生过更可怕的事情？

[来自[url=https://fflo.itch.io/a-postcard-from-finland]Itch.io[/url]]
